title: The Skeleton Lake of the Himalayas

lines.text: High in the Himalayas lies a frozen lake called Roopkund.
lines.visual: a frozen glacial lake high in snowy mountains at night

lines.text: Around it lie hundreds of human skeletons.
lines.visual: a dark mysterious shoreline with old bones under a single lamp

lines.text: A forest ranger found them in 1942.
lines.visual: a forest guard with a lantern discovering something in the dark

lines.text: People believed one storm killed them all.
But in 2019, scientists tested their DNA.
lines.visual: a scientist examining DNA samples in a lab

lines.text: They died in different groups, centuries apart.
lines.visual: DNA strands next to old case files on a desk

lines.text: Why they all ended up here is still unsolved.
lines.visual: the dark lake under a single light, a case file marked unsolved
